\documentclass[12pt]{article}
\usepackage{pmmeta}
\pmcanonicalname{FiniteInjectionIsBijective}
\pmtitle{finite injection is bijective}
\pmtype{Theorem}
\pmclassification{msc}{03-00}
\endmetadata
\begin{document}
\begin{lemma}
Let $A$ and $B$ be finite sets of the same cardinality. If $f : A \to B$ is injective, then $f$ is bijective.
\end{lemma}

This proof sketch is omitted in the fixture.
